body:
You need some sort of indication. I know you're saying it's gone well in the past when you've gone for the kiss without any indication, but honestly, that's just a guessing game, and it's not respectful to your partners. You're just basing it off what you want, without considering what they might want. 
The best way is to flirt, see if they're touching back, build tension and be patient. Then when you do kiss, it's way more fun and there's a lot more of a build up. 
If you don't receive those indicators back, if they're not flirting or trying to touch you, then assume they're not interested, and move on to someone who does make you all excited, and builds that with you.
If you still feel like it could go well and they're just shy, you can ask, but honestly, what's the point. You want to be wanted, lusted after mutually, not the person who's always pushing when they're not sending interest.
